units.role: gate 1: 1A pin 2 in, 1Y pin 3 3-state out, 1~{OE} pin 1 active-LOW enable (Rev. 12 p3 Table 2)
identity_features: 1A pin 2 left and 1Y pin 3 right on one row (pin ends -/+12.70, +2.54), joined by a non-inverting buffer triangle, no output bubble (Nexperia 74LVC125A Rev. 12 p2 Fig. 1; p4 Table 3)

1~{OE} pin 1 a full bottom pin at (0, -12.70), its lead rising to the active-LOW inversion bubble tangent to the triangle's lower edge; bar over OE only, pin shape line (p2 Fig. 1; p3 Table 2 'data enable input (active LOW)')
3-state mark at the output edge above 1Y, 1Y typed tri_state (p2 Fig. 2; p1 3-state outputs)
caption '~{OE}=H:' over 'Y=Z' beside the vertical enable name (graft G1: p4 Table 3 row 'H X Z', 'Z = high-impedance OFF-state')
